root_cause.text: The `idxd_conf_device_release()` function, which is the release callback for the configuration device, did not include a call to `destroy_workqueue()` for the `idxd->wq` workqueue, causing a resource leak because the workqueue allocated during device initialization was never cleaned up when the device object was freed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `destroy_workqueue(idxd->wq);` inside `idxd_conf_device_release()`, directly addressing the omission described in the commit message: "The workqueue associated with an DSA/IAA device is not released when the object is freed."
